verdicts.evidence: The author declined the hardening in the 67d58de follow-up comment: attestations are self-authenticating, and gating on the proposal would degrade VERIFIED checks on partial fetches. Commit 67d58de only adds a comment explaining this, at deriveCheckState.ts ~line 82; the logic did not change.
types/snapshot.ts:27 still declares `events: NormalizedCheckEvent[]`. The author's follow-up comment does not mention this item, and 67d58de did not touch the file.
Commit 67d58de adds an 'order independence' test in deriveCheckState.test.ts that asserts a reversed event set derives the same status. The author's follow-up comment calls this out.
The author skipped item (2) in the follow-up comment because the UNVERIFIED/PENDING fallthrough is already pinned by tests. No exhaustive switch was added in 67d58de.

Commit 67d58de adds the requested invariant note on `hasNegativeVerdict` about the coupling between resolveDispute and OracleResult (deriveCheckState.ts ~lines 38-43). The author's comment confirms it.
The author skipped item (6), saying `deadlineBlockOf` is a per-poll fold over a handful of events and is cold. `BigInt(event.deadlineBlock)` remains at deriveCheckState.ts:23.
